name: teamspeak6-server
description: TeamSpeak 6 Server Beta - The next generation of TeamSpeak voice communication server. Includes a 32-slot Beta License that is renewed every two months during the beta period. Supports voice communication for gaming, education, business, and personal use with high security standards and excellent voice quality. If container fails to start due to permission errors, run: chmod 777 /mnt/user/appdata/teamspeak6-server/ -R

paths.name: Server Data
paths.description: Directory for TeamSpeak 6 server data including database, logs, and configuration files. If container fails to start due to permission errors, run: chmod 777 /mnt/user/appdata/teamspeak6-server/ -R

ports.name: Web Query Port
ports.description: TCP port for Web Query API (optional). Leave empty to disable.

variables.name: TSSERVER_LICENSE_ACCEPTED
variables.description: Must be set to 'accept' to accept the TeamSpeak license agreement.

variables.name: TSSERVER_DEFAULT_PORT
variables.description: Default voice port for the first virtual server.

variables.name: TSSERVER_QUERY_HTTP_ENABLED
variables.description: Set to 1 to enable HTTP Web Query interface.

variables.name: TSSERVER_QUERY_HTTP_PORT
variables.description: Port for HTTP Web Query interface.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for the container process.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for the container process.
